title: stdio server
description: Local process server speaking MCP over stdin/stdout. Selected when type is "stdio" or omitted.

type.description: Transport type. Optional: an entry without type is read as stdio.

command.description: Executable that starts the server. Supports ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} environment-variable expansion. Plugin servers also substitute ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} and ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}. Use an absolute path for local scripts.

args.description: Arguments passed to command, one string each. Supports ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} environment-variable expansion.

env.description: Environment variables set for the server process (string values). Supports ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} environment-variable expansion. Claude Code also sets CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. Do not store secrets here in shared files.

timeout.description: Per-server wall-clock limit for one tool call, in milliseconds. Overrides MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT for this server; values below 1000 are ignored. Also floors the idle timeout. Progress notifications do not extend it.
